configuration.objective: weighted child SSE of the original 16 theta*g values; no class labels or preselected frequency codebook
configuration.fixed_constraint: all nodes at a depth share a single feature index
configuration.depth_policy: complete depth four; no early stopping; all 16 terminal IDs remain distinct
configuration.ties: lowest unused feature index; features do not repeat on a path
configuration.empty_leaf: zero centroid; identity retained and unseen validation hits counted
configuration.inference: node=0; repeat four times: j=features_heap[node]; node=2*node+1+((word>>j)&1); code=node-15
configuration.lookup_layout: sse_tree_lookups.npz keys fixed_level_index/node_specific_index; shape[24,65536], uint8 leaf code
configuration.scope: MADDNESS binary regression-tree core migration; ridge code-table optimization is a separate common downstream comparator
